newsitem.title: UK: Commonwealth team to observe Papua New Guinea poll.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth team to observe Papua New Guinea poll.

text.p: A 10-strong delegation from the Commonwealth will observe a parliamentary election in Papua New Guinea from June 14 to 28, Secretary-General Emeka Anyaoku said on Tuesday.
The visit follows an invitation from the government of the South Pacific nation. Robin Gray, a former minister in New Zealand, will lead the delegation.

"The group is mandated to consider the various factors impinging on the credibility of the electoral process as a whole, and to determine in its own judgement whether the conditions exist for a free expression of will by the electors, and if the results of the election reflect the wishes of the people of Papua New Guinea," the organisation of former British colonies said in a statement.

The island state came to international attention earlier this year when an army revolt stymied government plans to use mercenaries to put an end to a nine-year rebellion by separatists on Bougainville island.
It was the worst crisis in the nation's 22 years of independence and led to street protests and caused Prime Minister Sir Julius Chan to step down in April.
The caretaker government has pledged to resolve the rebellion by peaceful means.
